source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: [Bug 1915098 comments11–12](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1915098#c11) records a failed ESR 128 uplift: this.cards.values().filter is not a function. The author first blamed values; the reviewer corrected the missing method to iterator filter. The receiver is a Map iterator, so an Array filter rule does not establish compatibility. Check the actual target Gecko API when uplifting this pattern. Approval and mainline acceptance did not establish ESR execution support. This is historical reported failure, not a new ESR run or a current global ban on iterator helpers.
title: Check the iterator receiver and target branch before uplifting a helper call
